## 🤖 codx-junior

**codx-junior** is an **AI-powered coding assistant** and development tool designed to help developers write, review, and manage code more efficiently.

### Key Features:
- 🧠 **AI Code Generation** – Uses LLMs to generate and modify code
- 💬 **Chat Interface** – Interact with AI through a conversational UI
- 📁 **Project Awareness** – Understands your project structure and context
- 🔄 **Code Refactoring** – Helps improve and restructure existing code
- 📝 **Multi-file Editing** – Can work across multiple files in a project

### Architecture:
| Layer | Technology |
|-------|------------|
| **API** | Python (FastAPI) |
| **Frontend** | Vue.js / Node.js |
| **AI Backend** | LLM integration (OpenAI, etc.) |
| **Runtime** | Docker / self-hosted |

codx-junior/
├── api/          # Backend API (Python)
├── client/       # Frontend UI (Vue.js)
├── docs/         # Documentation
└── docker/       # Container configs
